Question:

answer: SELECT avg(LifeExpectancy) FROM country WHERE Name NOT IN (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T")

prefix_hints.hint_3: Project the names of countries meeting those official-English conditions to form the exclusion set: `SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = "English" AND T2.IsOfficial = "T"`.
prefix_hints.hint_4: Select from the country table and exclude every country name returned by the official-English subquery: `FROM country WHERE Name NOT IN (SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language = "English" AND T2.IsOfficial = "T")`.

  `Name` TEXT,
  `Birth_Year` NUMBER,
  `Net_Worth_Millions` NUMBER,
  `Citizenship` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`Singer_ID`)
);

  `Song_ID` NUMBER,
  `Title` TEXT,
  `Singer_ID` NUMBER REFERENCES `singer`(`Singer_ID`),

  `Highest_Position` NUMBER,

);

Question:
Show the names of singers and the total sales of their songs.
answer: SELECT T1.Name ,  sum(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

prefix_hints.hint_2: Link each singer to their songs through the shared `Singer_ID` column: `JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID`.
prefix_hints.hint_3: Group the joined song records by singer name so each singer produces one result row: `GROUP BY T1.Name`.
prefix_hints.hint_4: Calculate each singer's total song sales by summing the `Sales` values within each group: `sum(T2.Sales)`.
prefix_hints.hint_5: Project the singer name alongside the aggregated sales total in the SELECT clause: `SELECT T1.Name, sum(T2.Sales)`.
